title: Cell Culture Sample Analysis with FlowJo Software and ToPro 3 Staining
summary: This cluster involves the analysis of cell culture samples using FlowJo software. The samples are diluted in Milli-Q H2O and stored in unautoclaved 1.6-mL Eppendorf tubes. ToPro 3 staining is used to supplement the samples, which are then analyzed using FlowJo software. The analysis is likely performed on a Cytek DxP Cytometer, and the Shimadzu Nexera X2 series UHPLC system may be used for further analysis of the samples.
